sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Choose your preferred AI provider (OpenAI or Gemini AI)
  4. Enter and save your API key
  5. Customize your settings
  6. Start generating descriptions (single or bulk)
  7. Review and save your products
sections.faq:
Is AI Product Tools free to use?

Yes! The core features and 500 generation credits are completely free. You only need an API key from your chosen provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini AI).

How does the credit system work?

Each product content generation (including descriptions and tags) uses 1 credit. Free users start with 500 credits, Pro users get 5000 credits, and Business users enjoy unlimited credits. Credits are automatically renewed monthly.

How does the bulk generation work?

Our powerful bulk generator allows you to create descriptions and tags for multiple products simultaneously:
– Free users: Generate up to 500 products per month
– Pro users: Generate up to 5000 products per month
– Business users: Unlimited generation
The bulk generator includes features like category filtering, batch processing, progress tracking, and generation history.

Can I pause and resume bulk generation?

Yes! Our smart bulk generation system allows you to pause, resume, and even cancel generation processes. Your progress is automatically saved, and you can continue from where you left off.

What happens if I run out of credits?

When you run out of credits, you can either wait for the monthly renewal or upgrade to a higher plan for more credits. Pro and Business users get priority in the generation queue.

Which AI provider should I choose?

Both OpenAI and Gemini AI deliver excellent results. OpenAI (ChatGPT) excels in creative writing, while Gemini AI often provides more structured, technical content. Try both to find what works best for your products!

Is the content SEO-friendly?

Absolutely! All generated descriptions are optimized for search engines while maintaining readability and engagement. The AI considers keywords, product attributes, and SEO best practices.

Can I customize the AI-generated descriptions?

Yes! You can customize:
– AI Provider selection
– Language preferences
– Writing style
– Description length
– Custom prompts with variables
– Custom fields integration (map any product fields to variables like {custom1})
– Brand voice
– Product attributes integration
– Bulk generation templates

The custom fields feature is especially powerful – it lets you take any product-specific information (technical specs, materials, benefits, etc.) and tell AI to specifically highlight these details in your descriptions. This creates truly unique content that perfectly showcases what makes each product special!

Is my data secure?

Yes! We prioritize security. Your API keys and product data are stored securely on your WordPress installation. We never store or access your API keys or product information on our servers.

What makes AI Product Tools different from other AI description generators?

AI Product Tools stands out with its powerful bulk generation system, smart tag generation, dual AI provider support, and extensive customization options. Our focus on efficiency and scalability makes it perfect for both small shops and large WooCommerce stores with thousands of products.

What is the “Improve Descriptions” feature?

Our innovative “Improve Descriptions” feature allows you to enhance your existing product descriptions without starting from scratch. Simply select the products you want to improve, click the “Improve Existing Products” option in the toolbar, and watch as AI enhances your content while maintaining your original messaging. Perfect for refreshing your product catalog or improving underperforming listings!

Can I keep parts of my existing descriptions when generating new ones?

Absolutely! With our new “Keep Existing Descriptions” feature, you can preserve the valuable parts of your current product descriptions while still benefiting from AI-powered enhancements. This gives you the perfect balance between fresh content and maintaining your established brand voice.

How do I use custom fields with AI Product Tools?

It’s simple! Here’s how custom fields and variables work:

  1. Add variables to your prompts: Include placeholders like {custom1}, {custom2} in your templates
  2. Map variables to your existing fields: In settings, connect each variable to a specific custom field
  3. Generate content: The AI will automatically use your custom field values in the content

Perfect for highlighting specific product features like materials, specifications, benefits, or any other custom attributes you already track!

sections.description:
Revolutionize your WooCommerce store with AI magic! Bulk generate thousands of stunning product descriptions and tags powered by ChatGPT & Gemini AI.

🚀 The Ultimate AI-Powered Bulk Product Content Generator for WooCommerce

AI Product Tools revolutionizes how you create product content in WooCommerce. Powered by industry-leading AI technology from OpenAI (ChatGPT) and Google’s Gemini AI, this plugin helps you generate compelling, SEO-friendly product descriptions and tags in seconds, not hours.

⚡ NEW: Powerful Bulk Generation

Generate professional product descriptions and tags for your entire catalog in minutes! Free users start with 500 generation credits, while Pro users enjoy up to 5000 credits for massive catalogs.

🎯 NEW: Custom Fields & Variables Integration

Take precise control over your AI-generated content with our powerful custom fields integration. Map existing custom fields to prompt variables (e.g. {custom1}, {custom2}) to create ultra-targeted product descriptions.

How Custom Variables Feature Work:

  1. Insert Variables in Prompts: Add {custom1}, {custom2}, etc. in your AI prompts
  2. Map Fields to Variables: Select which custom field corresponds to each variable
  3. Generate Content: The AI uses your custom field data in your descriptions

For example, if you have a “material” custom field with value “100% organic cotton” and a “benefits” field with “hypoallergenic, eco-friendly”, you can create a prompt like:
“Write a product description that highlights that this product is made from {custom1} and emphasize these benefits: {custom2}”

The AI will then generate content that specifically focuses on the organic cotton material and the hypoallergenic and eco-friendly benefits of your products!

🏷️ NEW: Smart Tag Generation

Automatically generate relevant and SEO-optimized product tags along with your descriptions. Our AI understands your products and creates tags that improve discoverability and categorization. Now with bulk generation support and tag history tracking!

🔄 NEW: Enhanced Content Generation

Create richer content with HTML support in both prompts and descriptions. Use dynamic variables in your prompts (e.g. {custom1}) for more personalized content. Your generation history is automatically managed with a 30-day retention policy for optimal performance.

🔄 NEW: Bulk Improve Existing Products

Already have product content? Our “Improve Descriptions” feature intelligently enhances your existing product content with just one click. Make your product pages more compelling, SEO-friendly, and conversion-focused without starting from scratch!

📺 Checkout a quick overview of AI Product Tools 2.1.0:

🌟 Why Choose AI Product Tools?

  • 🚀 Bulk Generation Power: Process up to 5000 products at once
  • 🤖 Dual AI Integration: Choose between OpenAI (ChatGPT) or Google’s Gemini AI
  • 🏷️ Smart Tag Generation: Auto-generate SEO-optimized product tags in bulk
  • 📝 Complete Content Solution: Generate both descriptions and tags in one click
  • 🎯 Custom Fields & Variables: Map custom fields to variables for precision targeting
  • 🌍 Multi-Language Support: Generate content in any language
  • 📱 Mobile-Friendly: Work seamlessly from any device
  • 🔒 Secure: Your data and API keys are always protected
  • 🎯 SEO-Optimized: AI-generated content designed for better search rankings
  • 💰 Time & Cost Efficient: Save hours of manual writing time
  • 🔄 Easy Integration: Seamless WooCommerce integration
  • ✨ Content Enhancement: Improve existing descriptions and tags with one click

Key Features

* Pro Plan: 5000 generation credits
* Business Plan: Unlimited generation
* Batch processing capabilities
* Progress tracking
* Generation history
* Export/Import support
* Enhanced filtering options including stock status

✨ Advanced AI Integration
* OpenAI (ChatGPT) Integration with all models
* Google Gemini AI Integration with Gemini Pro
* Easy provider switching
* Flexible API key management
* Optimized prompt templates for better results

✨ Content Generation
* Long-form Product Descriptions
* Short Product Descriptions (Excerpts)
* Smart Product Tag Generation with bulk support
* HTML-enabled prompts and descriptions
* Dynamic variable support in prompts
* Precision content targeting with custom variables from custom fields
* Custom AI Prompts with variable support
* Brand Voice Customization
* Category-based bulk generation
* “Improve Existing Products” capability
* “Keep Existing Content” option
* Automatic history management
* Tag history tracking

✨ Smart Features
* Category-aware Descriptions
* Price-sensitive Content
* Product Attribute Integration
* Custom Fields & Variables Integration
* SKU Integration
* Tag-based Generation
* Bulk editing capabilities
* Description improvement technology
* Variable support with “+” icon in prompts
* Custom fields to variables mapping ({custom1}, {custom2}, etc.)
* Separate short and full description control

✨ Customization Options
* Multiple Language Support
* Writing Style Selection
* Content Length Control
* Custom Prompt Templates
* Brand Voice Settings
* Intuitive settings interface with separate pages
* Plan status monitoring and updates
* Enhanced prompt structure tools

Pro Features

🔥 Premium Features (Pro Plan)
* 5000 generation credits
* Priority customer support
* Exclusive premium features
* Advanced bulk generation options
* New features and improvements
* Prompt Templates (coming soon)

🌟 Business Features
